reference_transcript: I have been feeling dizzy since Monday, especially when I stand up quickly. I sometimes feel nauseous, but I have not vomited. Have you had chest pain, shortness of breath, blurred vision, fainting, or weakness in your arms or legs? No, I have not had any of those symptoms. I have been drinking less water than usual because I have been very busy. Are you currently taking any regular medication? No, I am not taking any regular medication. Your symptoms may be related to dehydration, although we should continue to monitor them. Increase your fluid intake and stand up slowly rather than suddenly. I am not prescribing any new medication today. What should I do if the dizziness continues? Come back for review in three days if it has not improved. If you faint, develop chest pain, severe shortness of breath, or new weakness, seek urgent medical attention.
